## Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): e side n = +3.2×10¹², h side n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw first: run 6 (`data/6`, B 0→10 T, 10 mT above 1 T) and run 7 (`data/7`, B 10→0.3 T, 20 mT), sr1 50 µV, I ≈ 10 nA, T_sample ≈ 1.24 K; leakage clean on both (|I_gate| ≤ 220 pA, flyback-scale transients). **Read (run 6, electron):** clear SdH from ~1.4–1.9 T; quantum-Hall-like Rxx minima approaching 0 by ~6 T. FFT (1.5–10 T, 1/B) is a **comb spaced by ≈7.1 T**: 7.1 / 14.1 / 22.9 / **30.0 (dominant)** / 37.0 / 44.1 / 51.2 / 58.2 — the natural read is a **two-band metal**: light orbit F_l ≈ 7.1 T (+harmonic 14.1), heavy orbit F_h ≈ 30.0 T, magnetic-breakdown/combination sidebands F_h ± k·F_l (22.9, 37.0, 44.1…). **Lever-arm consistency:** F_h + F_l = 37.1 T vs F_total(g=4, geometry-prior n) = 33.1 T → the absolute n scale reads **+12% vs the c_tg(9.5 nm) prior**, which dovetails with run 5's ratio being −11% below prior *iff c_bg is correct and c_tg is ~12% larger* (hBN nearer ~8.5 nm) — a data-side lever-arm calibration, to be confirmed by the fan's ν-line slopes. **Read (run 7, hole):** oscillations from ~0.7–1.3 T; harmonic-rich ladder 5.3 / 12.3 / 21.2 / 28.2 T (not a clean single-F comb; near-CNP multi-band/spin-split content; F_total(g=4) = 12.4 T at prior scale, ~13.9 T rescaled). **Verdict-relevant:** two occupied bands with very different F at D = 0 on the electron side is anti-ABCA-single-band evidence but does not yet separate ABAB from ABCB, and single-trace FFTs can't separate bands / harmonics / the region-B mosaic (run 5). The discriminator is **F(n) branch structure + the LL fan degeneracy pattern** → Landau fan (plan step 4). Channel arithmetic: R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6).

"""Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw traces, background-subtracted
oscillations in 1/B, and SdH FFTs with the peak table. Sum-rule check against
F_total = n h / (4e)."""
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

E12 = 1e16  # 1e12 cm^-2 in m^-2
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 8))
for row, (rid, nspot, lab) in enumerate([(6, +3.2, 'run 6 — electron, n = +3.2e12'),
                                         (7, -1.2, 'run 7 — hole, n = -1.2e12')]):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    R = r.col('sr1_X') / (r.col('sr0_X') / -1e6)   # (V/gain)/I, signed
    F_tot = abs(nspot) * E12 * cst.h / (4 * cst.e)

    ax = axes[row, 0]
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel('B (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('Rxx (Ohm)'); ax.set_title(lab)

    m = B > 1.5
    Bs = np.sort(B[m]); Rs = R[m][np.argsort(B[m])]
    bg = np.polyval(np.polyfit(Bs, Rs, 5), Bs)
    ax = axes[row, 1]
    ax.plot(1 / Bs, Rs - bg, lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel('1/B (1/T)'); ax.set_ylabel('dRxx (Ohm)')
    ax.set_title('oscillation, B > 1.5 T, poly5 removed')

    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, 10), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    sp = spec[0]
    noise = np.median(sp[freqs > 150])
    pk, _ = find_peaks(sp, height=10 * noise, distance=3)
    pk = [p for p in pk if 2 < freqs[p] < 120]
    ax = axes[row, 2]
    ax.plot(freqs, sp, lw=0.8)
    ax.axvline(F_tot, color='g', ls='--', lw=1, label=f'F_total(g=4) = {F_tot:.1f} T')
    for p in pk[:8]:
        ax.axvline(freqs[p], color='r', ls=':', lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 120); ax.set_xlabel('F (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('|FFT|')
    ax.set_title('SdH FFT in 1/B (1.5–10 T)'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    print(f'run {rid}: F_total(g=4) = {F_tot:.1f} T; R(B_min) = {R[np.argmin(B)]:.0f} Ohm, '
          f'R(10 T) = {R[np.argmax(B)]:.0f} Ohm; peaks (F, amp):')
    print('   ' + ', '.join(f'{freqs[p]:.1f} T ({sp[p]:.2g})' for p in pk[:8]))
fig.tight_layout()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan along D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 → +3.20×10¹², B 1 → 10 T

> **05:28** · landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25 -> +3.20e12, 151 pts co-swept (Vtg,Vbg); B 1 -> 10 T, 100 mT, 91 rows; sr1 500 uV (50 kOhm FS), 10 nA; ends 10 T @ n=+3.2e12 · **ETA ~11:28** (≈6h)

**Plan step 4 — the stacking-call measurement.** Runs 6/7 (ana cells 14–15) show a two-band electron side (F_l ≈ 7.1 T, F_h ≈ 30.0 T, breakdown comb) and a harmonic-rich hole side — single traces can't separate bands / harmonics / the region-B mosaic, and the +12% n-scale question (F_h+F_l = 37.1 T vs prior-scale 33.1 T) needs the fan's ν-line slopes. The fan delivers: F(n) branch structure both signs, absolute-n lever-arm from ν slopes, the principal-gap degeneracy pattern (ABAB vs ABCA vs ABCB discriminator), and ν = 0 vs B. **Grid:** fast axis co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) along D = 0 (run-5 cal, `cal_run5.json`), n = −1.25 → +3.20×10¹² in 151 pts (Δn ≈ 3.0×10¹⁰, ~8 pts per ν = 1 spacing at 10 T; V_tg ∈ [−0.291, +0.984], V_bg ∈ [−0.484, +1.166], inside validators); slow axis B = 1.0 → 10.0 T, 100 mT, 91 rows, ascending from the magnet's current 0 T (never re-traverse; ends at 10 T with gates at the e-side end for a ride-down follow-up). **Coverage trades:** B < 1 T excluded (T_e ≈ 8 K kills LL structure there; runs 6/7 already cover 0–1 T at two densities) — full-range price ~35 min for washed-out rows; |n| beyond the window is TG-limited (hole side reaches only −1.25×10¹²), full h-side symmetry is not available on this device. **Sensitivity:** sr1 fixed 500 µV = 50 kΩ FS at 10 nA (run-4 lesson: ≥10× the 2.9 kΩ 0 T ridge). The ν = 0/CNP stripe at high B will likely exceed 50 kΩ and rail — accepted and stated: that region is read qualitatively (insulating), SdH/gap structure elsewhere stays quantitative; 15 nV LSB ≪ the 0.1–1 µV SdH amplitudes of runs 6/7. **Dwell:** fast_delay 1.0 s (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB — 3.3τ, bent knowingly: 8.5/11 mV steps, features span many points; identical to run-5 practice that produced the calibration). **Price:** 91 rows × (151 × 1.1 s/pt [run-5 calibrated] + 44 s ramp + ~8 s turnaround) + 7.3 min initial ramp ≈ 5.7 h → **ETA 6 h** (session lesson: actuals run 5–10% over). **Checkpoints:** first rows ~15 min (rails / leakage / signal / field tracking); interim reads at ~3 T and ~6 T (partial fan re-form + FFT; abort criteria: railed off-CNP, sustained leak > 1 nA, dead channel). Leak guard trips the sweep at 1 nA. Preconditions: T ≈ 1.2 K, B ≈ 0, V_si = 0, nplci 1/1, PS heater + output on.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): D = 0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25 -> +3.20e12 (151 pts, co-swept TG+BG fast) x B 1 -> 10 T (100 mT, 91 rows slow) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts with the 0->1 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- fast axis: D = 0 line, n = -1.25 .. +3.20e12 in 151 pts (dn ~ 3.0e10; ~8 pts per nu=1 at 10 T) ---
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.20, 151)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())

# --- slow axis: B ascending from where the magnet sits ---
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.1), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 500 uV = 50 kOhm FS at 10 nA.
# The nu=0/CNP stripe at high B may exceed 50 kOhm and rail -- accepted (read qualitatively there);
# 15 nV LSB keeps runs-6/7-scale SdH (0.1-1 uV) quantitative everywhere else.
sr1.sensitivity(500e-6)
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12, Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} ({len(n_vec)} pts); slow: B {B_vec[0]}..{B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows)")
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (50 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25..+3.20e12 co-swept TG+BG 151 pts fast; "
                  "B 1..10 T 100 mT 91 rows slow; sr1 500 uV; leak trip 1 nA")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}): n = -1.25..+3.20e12 cm^-2, 151 pts co-swept (Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, '
              f'Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f}); B = 1..10 T, 100 mT, 91 rows ascending; sr1 500 uV, 10 nA')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# ends at B = 10 T, gates at the e-side end (n = +3.2e12) -- next step rides the field down; no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing.
